Facts from the prospectus: the company is a consumer Li-ion maker (S4) with a single production base in Zhaoqing, Guangdong (phase I and II buildings about 36 mu and 75,000 m2 floor area, p.1-1-66); two cell lines of products: polymer (pouch) cells and aluminium-shell cells (S3); main customer Transsion (phones). Production table p.1-1-66 (unit 万只 = 10,000 cells; NOT convertible to GWh because no Wh per cell is stated): polymer cells/batteries capacity 6,000 (2023), 7,500 (2024), 1,875 (2025 Jan-Mar); output 4,617.17, 6,364.20, 1,334.86; utilisation 76.95%, 84.86%, 71.19%. Aluminium-shell cells capacity 5,000, 6,400, 1,600; output 4,570.74, 5,884.46, 1,267.46; utilisation 91.41%, 91.94%, 79.22%. So about 139 million cells/yr of design capacity in 2024 and about 122 million produced; 2024 revenue RMB 1,289 million (p.1-1-61 text via search summary; not quoted). A GWh equivalent would need an assumed Wh/cell (phone cells ~10-20 Wh would imply about 1.4-2.8 GWh) - this is an inference, NOT entered; the >=0.5 GWh threshold of the task is therefore plausible but not sourced. Status operational: the table reports actual production (S1 base, S4 business) and the prospectus describes mass-production lines. nameplate/installed/ref_year/start_year left null (rule 5). Chemistry LCO: S5 says the company applies LCO blended with ternary material; supplier table shows cobalt-oxide cathode purchases (华友钴业, 格林美, 巴斯夫杉杉) - ternary and LMO R&D also appear, so chemistry may be LCO/NMC blend. cell_format mixed = pouch (polymer) + prismatic aluminium-shell; 18650 cylindrical R&D projects are listed but production lines are not stated. Registered address per search summary: 肇庆市端州区三榕东路3号 (not read on the page; no coordinates entered). Confidence 0.5: single company document (draft filing), capacity unit not GWh.
